selection_rule: every '(PIN)' name in BlueBookV2.pdf that passes the protocol's scope filters, is read by OPSIN without an ambiguity warning, and whose structure the project has not already looked at; assigned to a half by a hash of the InChIKey within its chapter (tools/naming_bluebook_harvest.py)
stage: the harvest is scored by tools/naming_stage_artifact.py like any population; `pubchem_name` holds the book's printed PIN
